plugins.name: clawdevbox-mcp
plugins.description: Registers the clawdevbox MCP server with the configured CLI. After install, any session that CLI spawns can call recipe.*, trigger.*, inbox.*, artifact.*, plugin.*, and the other clawdevbox tools.

plugins.name: dev-buddy
plugins.description: Workspace persona for the clawdevbox main agent. Catches users up on workspace state on /catchup, surfaces inbox items, and helps schedule or run recipes.

plugins.name: ado
plugins.description: Azure DevOps: PR review, comments, iterations, and cold/hot/pulse triggers.
